REG0000.description: MPAN Invalid or does not exist.
REG0000.reason: The MPAN Core provided in the request does not exist in the Registration Service or fails the standard checksum validation.
REG0000.resolution: Verify the MPAN Core is correct and has 13 digits. Check the MPAN against a trusted source before resubmitting the interface.

REG0001.description: Data Block 'Removed Meter' cannot be used with Event [MeterInstall]
REG0001.reason: The request is for a meter installation but incorrectly includes data for a meter removal.
REG0001.resolution: Remove the 'Removed Meter' data block from the interface payload and resubmit.

REG0002.description: Data Block 'Installed/Updated Meter' cannot be used with [MeterRemoved]
REG0002.reason: The request is for a meter removal but incorrectly includes data for a meter installation or update.
REG0002.resolution: Remove the 'Installed/Updated Meter' data block from the interface payload and resubmit.

REG0003.description: Event/Operation cannot be undertaken when Connection Type is Unmetered
REG0003.reason: The requested action, such as a meter update or appointment, is not applicable to an MPAN with an unmetered connection type.
REG0003.resolution: Verify the MPAN is correct. If the MPAN is unmetered, this operation is not permitted. Check that the intended action is suitable for an unmetered supply.

REG0004.description: Event/Operation cannot be undertaken when Mk. Segment is Unmetered
REG0004.reason: The requested action is not applicable to an MPAN with an unmetered market segment.
REG0004.resolution: Verify the MPAN is correct. If the MPAN market segment is unmetered, this operation is not permitted.

REG0005.description: CSS Registration Request ID is invalid or does not exist
REG0005.reason: The Central Switching Service (CSS) Registration Request ID provided does not correspond to a valid, active switching process.
REG0005.resolution: Ensure the CSS Registration Request ID is valid and associated with an active switch for the sending supplier.

REG0006.description: CSS Registration Request ID is associated to another Supplier
REG0006.reason: The CSS Registration Request ID provided is for a switch being performed by a different supplier.
REG0006.resolution: Verify that the Sender ID matches the Supplier ID associated with the CSS Registration Request ID.

REG0007.description: Cannot manage MPAN Relationship during a Switch
REG0007.reason: An attempt was made to create, modify, or dissolve an MPAN relationship while the MPAN is undergoing a change of supplier.
REG0007.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the MPAN is not subject to an active switch. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG0008.description: Amendment Requested cannot be undertaken by Previous Metering Service
REG0008.reason: The previous Metering Service is attempting to make an update outside the allowed 10-working-day window or is trying to update fields other than the meter location.
REG0008.resolution: Ensure the update is made within 10 working days of the appointment end date and only modifies the meter location. All other changes must be performed by the current Metering Service.

REG0009.description: Null Value cannot be set as Value held is already Null
REG0009.reason: An update was sent to set a data item to null, but the current value for that data item is already null.
REG0009.resolution: Do not attempt to set a value to null if the existing value is already null. Check the data item (e.g., SMSO, IHD Status, SSC, or Profile Class) before sending the update.

REG1001.reason: The operation requires the Metering Point (MP) or Registration Metering Point (RMP) to have a status of 'Created' or 'Operational', but it is currently in another state (e.g., 'Disconnected').
REG1001.resolution: Ensure the MPAN's RMP status is either 'Created' or 'Operational' before proceeding.

REG1002.description: No Valid Appointment held by Metering Service on Relevant Date
REG1002.reason: The Metering Service sending the request did not have a valid appointment for the MPAN on the date specified for the meter installation.
REG1002.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the sending Metering Service ID is currently appointed or held a valid appointment for the meter installation date. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1003.description: Post Appointment Update Period has Expired
REG1003.reason: A former Metering Service is attempting to update meter details after the allowed 10-working-day period following their appointment end date has passed.
REG1003.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the update is sent within 10 working days of the previous appointment end date. After this period, updates must be sent by the current appointed service provider.

REG1004.description: Meter ID does not match existing Installed Meter(s)
REG1004.reason: The Meter ID provided for a meter to be updated or removed does not match any of the currently installed meter IDs for the MPAN.
REG1004.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the removed meter ID matches an existing installed meter ID. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1005.description: Meter Removal Date cannot be prior to Install Date
REG1005.reason: The provided date for meter removal is earlier than the date the same meter was installed.
REG1005.resolution: To resolve this, ensure that for the specified meter ID, the meter removal date is on or after its existing installation date. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1006.description: Meter with same Meter ID already Installed
REG1006.reason: An attempt was made to install a meter with a Meter ID that is already registered as installed at this MPAN.
REG1006.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the meter ID being installed does not match an existing installed meter ID for this MPAN. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1007.description: Meter Install Date must be prior to Disconnection Date
REG1007.reason: A meter installation is being recorded with a date that is on or after the MPAN's disconnection date.
REG1007.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the installation date is before the disconnection effective date. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1008.description: Meter Install Date cannot be prior to Removal Date for Exchange
REG1008.reason: In a meter exchange scenario, the new meter's installation date cannot be before the old meter's removal date.
REG1008.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the installation date is on or after the removal date for the exchanged meter. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1009.reason: The provided Meter Asset Provider (MAP) ID was not valid for the specified effective date according to Industry Standing Data (ISD).
REG1009.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the MAP ID is valid in ISD for the specified MAP effective date. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1010.description: MAP Effective Date cannot be prior to Meter Install Date
REG1010.reason: The effective date for the Meter Asset Provider (MAP) appointment cannot be earlier than the meter's installation date.
REG1010.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the MAP effective date is on or after the meter installation date. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1011.description: Meter Install Date cannot be Prior to MPAN Creation Date
REG1011.reason: The provided meter installation date is earlier than the date the MPAN was created in the system.
REG1011.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the installation date is on or after the MPAN creation date. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1012.description: Only Appointed MS can use Update Events
REG1012.reason: An update event was sent by a Metering Service that is not currently appointed to the MPAN.
REG1012.resolution: To resolve this, ensure that the sending Metering Service ID is the one currently appointed. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1013.description: Modified Meter ID already exists as an Installed Meter ID for MPAN
REG1013.reason: An attempt was made to change a meter's ID to a new ID that is already in use by another installed meter at the same MPAN.
REG1013.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the modified meter ID does not match any other existing installed meter ID for the MPAN. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1014.reason: When submitting multiple updates in one transaction, the 'effective from' dates are not in chronological order.
REG1014.resolution: Ensure that if multiple groups are included, their 'effective from' dates are in ascending chronological order. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1015.description: Meter ID does not exist so cannot be updated
REG1015.reason: An attempt was made to update details for a meter ID that is not currently recorded as installed or active for the MPAN.
REG1015.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the meter ID matches a currently installed/active meter for the MPAN. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1016.description: Install & Remove Meter ID's should match for Event
REG1016.reason: In a meter modification event, the meter ID specified in the 'removed' block does not match the meter ID in the 'install/update' block.
REG1016.resolution: To resolve this, ensure that in a modification event, the removed meter ID matches the meter ID being updated. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1017.description: Meter ID and Meter Install/Removed Date cannot be updated in the same transaction
REG1017.reason: The request attempts to change a meter's serial number (Meter ID) and its installation or removal date simultaneously, which is not permitted in a single transaction.
REG1017.resolution: To resolve this, submit separate transactions: one to update the meter ID and another to update the dates. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1018.description: Cannot use [MeterHistoryUpdate] to amend installed meter
REG1018.reason: The 'MeterHistoryUpdate' event is designed to correct historical meter records, not to modify the details of the currently installed meter.
REG1018.resolution: To update the currently installed meter, use the appropriate 'Update Meter' event. 'MeterHistoryUpdate' should only be used for meters that have already been removed.

REG1019.description: Event should be within Requesting Parties period of Responsibility
REG1019.reason: The effective date of the requested change falls outside the supplier's period of ownership for this MPAN.
REG1019.resolution: Ensure the 'effective from' date for the event is within the supplier's period of ownership and not before the Supplier Start Date (SSD).

REG1020.description: Event cannot take place in the future
REG1020.reason: The 'effective from' date for this specific event is required to be in the past or present.
REG1020.resolution: The 'effective from' date for this event cannot be set for a future date. Please adjust the date and resubmit.

REG1021.description: Requesting Supplier is not the Current Supplier
REG1021.reason: The action being performed is restricted to the supplier currently responsible for the MPAN.
REG1021.resolution: This action can only be performed by the current supplier for the MPAN. Please verify the sender is the currently appointed supplier.

REG1022.description: Proposed Data Item Value is invalid
REG1022.reason: The value proposed for a data item is not valid in combination with other existing attributes of the MPAN.
REG1022.resolution: The proposed value is invalid for the MPAN's current configuration. Check that the combination of Consent Granularity, Domestic Premises Indicator, Energy Direction, and Market Segment is valid.

REG1023.reason: The Smart Metering System Operator (SMSO) ID provided is not a valid, recognized identifier for the specified date.
REG1023.resolution: Verify that the provided SMSO ID is a valid identifier for the specified effective date.

REG1024.reason: The 'effective from' date for this event is too far in the past, exceeding the allowed window for backdating.
REG1024.resolution: The 'effective from' date cannot be set more than 5 days in the past. Please adjust the date and resubmit.

REG1025.description: Scenario USP can only be used with currently appointed Service Provider
REG1025.reason: The 'Update Service Provider' (USP) scenario was used, but the service provider ID in the request does not match the one currently appointed.
REG1025.resolution: When using the 'USP' scenario, the service provider in the request must be the one currently appointed.

REG1026.description: Scenario CSP cannot propose the currenly appointed Service Provider
REG1026.reason: The 'Change Service Provider' (CSP) scenario was used, but the new proposed service provider is the same as the one already appointed.
REG1026.resolution: When using the 'CSP' scenario, you must propose a new service provider, not the one that is currently appointed.

REG1027.description: Metering Service is not currently appointed and does not hold a Prospective SEG Appointment
REG1027.reason: An action was attempted by a Metering Service that is not currently appointed and also does not have a pending prospective appointment for a Smart Export Guarantee (SEG) scenario.
REG1027.resolution: To resolve this, ensure the metering service is the currently appointed metering service or has a proposed appointment with scenario 'SEG' in the queue. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1028.description: Meter Install/Removal Date Cannot be Null
REG1028.reason: A required meter installation date or removal date was not provided in the request.
REG1028.resolution: To resolve this, ensure that the installation date is not null/blank. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1029.description: Modified Meter Id Must be Null
REG1029.reason: The 'Revised Meter ID' field was populated in a transaction where it is not allowed, such as a simple date change.
REG1029.resolution: To resolve this, ensure that the revised meter ID field is null for this type of transaction. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1030.description: Metering Service not valid for Unmetered site in LDSO
REG1030.reason: The appointed Metering Service is not registered as a valid Unmetered Supplies Operator (UMSO) within the area of the specified Local Distribution System Operator (LDSO).
REG1030.resolution: Ensure the specified Metering Service is a valid Unmetered Supplies Operator (UMSO) for the given LDSO.

REG1031.description: Service Provider incompatible with MPAN Market Segment
REG1031.reason: The chosen Service Provider (e.g., Metering Operator or Data Collector) is not accredited to work with the MPAN's market segment (e.g., Smart, Advanced, etc.).
REG1031.resolution: The selected Service Provider (Metering or Data Service) is not compatible with the MPAN's current market segment. Please check the provider's valid segments and resubmit.

REG1032.description: Service Provider EffectiveFrom Date is not Contiguous / or is Invalid
REG1032.reason: The start date for the new service provider appointment creates a gap or overlap with the end date of the previous appointment, or it is not set to midnight.
REG1032.resolution: The Service Provider 'Effective From' Date is invalid. Ensure the date is equivalent to midnight local time and is contiguous with the previous appointment or Supplier Start Date.

REG1033.reason: The sender of the request is not the current supplier, but they are attempting to use an appointment scenario ('USP' or 'CSP') that is reserved for the current supplier.
REG1033.resolution: The Appointment Scenario ID is not valid because the sender is not the currently appointed supplier for a 'USP' or 'CSP' scenario.

REG1034.description: Prospective Appointment cannot be in the past
REG1034.reason: A supplier who is not yet current for the MPAN has tried to make a service provider appointment with an effective date in the past.
REG1034.resolution: For a prospective appointment made by a non-current supplier, the appointment date cannot be in the past. Please provide a current or future date.

REG1036.description: MDR EffectiveFrom Date must be within Suppliers Ownership
REG1036.reason: The proposed start date for the Meter Data Retriever (MDR) appointment is outside the supplier's period of responsibility for the MPAN.
REG1036.resolution: The Proposed MDR 'Effective From' Date must not be earlier than the Data Service Appointment date or the previous MDR's effective date.

REG1038.description: Appointments barred on Linked Export MPAN
REG1038.reason: Service provider appointments are managed on the primary Import MPAN, not on the associated Export MPAN.
REG1038.resolution: Service appointments cannot be made on a linked Export MPAN. Please use the associated Import MPAN for this request.

REG1039.description: Appointments barred on Related Secondary MPAN
REG1039.reason: Service provider appointments for a related group of MPANs must be made on the primary MPAN of that group.
REG1039.resolution: Service appointments are barred on a secondary MPAN in a related group. Please direct the request to the primary MPAN.

REG1040.description: SSD Effective From Date must be later than existing
REG1040.reason: An update to the Standard Settlement Configuration (SSC) or Profile Class has an effective date that is on or before the most recent existing record.
REG1040.resolution: The 'effective from' date for the SSC or Profile Class must be later than the most recent 'effective from' date already on record.

REG1041.description: Profile Class Effective From Date must be later than existing
REG1041.reason: The new Profile Class effective date is not after the current one on record.
REG1041.resolution: The Profile Class 'effective from' date must be greater than the latest Profile Class effective date on record.

REG1042.description: SSC Cannot be set to Null when installed Meter Type is Group Trad
REG1042.reason: Meters classified as 'Group Traditional' require a valid Standard Settlement Configuration (SSC) and it cannot be removed (set to null).
REG1042.resolution: You cannot set the Standard Settlement Configuration (SSC) to null when the installed meter type is 'Group Traditional'.

REG1043.description: PC Cannot be set to Null when installed Meter Type in Group Trad
REG1043.reason: Meters classified as 'Group Traditional' require a valid Profile Class (PC) and it cannot be removed (set to null).
REG1043.resolution: You cannot set the Profile Class (PC) to null when the installed meter type is 'Group Traditional'.

REG1044.description: SSC must be a valid value in ISD
REG1044.reason: The provided Standard Settlement Configuration (SSC) code does not exist in the master Industry Standing Data (ISD).
REG1044.resolution: The provided Standard Settlement Configuration (SSC) code is not a valid value. Please check against the Industry Standing Data (ISD) and resubmit.

REG1045.description: PC must be a valid value in ISD
REG1045.reason: The provided Profile Class (PC) code does not exist in the master Industry Standing Data (ISD).
REG1045.resolution: The provided Profile Class (PC) is not a valid value. Please check against the Industry Standing Data (ISD) and resubmit.

REG1046.reason: The Electricity Smart Meter Equipment (ESME) ID was populated for a non-smart meter, or was missing for a smart meter.
REG1046.resolution: The ESME ID must be populated if the meter type is 'smart meter group' and must not be populated otherwise. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1047.reason: The number of displayed register digits was not provided for a meter type that requires it (e.g., smart meters).
REG1047.resolution: The number of displayed register digits should be populated if the meter type is 'smart meter group'. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1048.reason: The provided meter location code is not a valid value according to the list of approved codes.
REG1048.resolution: The meter location value provided is invalid. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1049.description: Value provided for data item is not consistent with ISD
REG1049.reason: A data item, such as meter type, was provided that does not exist in the Industry Standing Data (ISD).
REG1049.resolution: The meter type provided does not exist in ISD. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1050.description: Supplier must have ownership of either Import/Export MPAN to maintain Relationships
REG1050.reason: An attempt was made to manage an Import/Export relationship without being the registered supplier for at least one of the involved MPANs.
REG1050.resolution: Verify that the requesting supplier is the current supplier for either the Import or the Export MPAN before creating or modifying the relationship.

REG1051.description: Unmetered MPANs cannot be part of an MPAN Relationship
REG1051.reason: MPAN relationships (Import/Export or Related) are only applicable to metered supplies.
REG1051.resolution: Ensure that all MPANs included in the relationship request are for metered supplies, not unmetered ones.

REG1052.description: MPAN(s) already part of an Import/Export Relationship
REG1052.reason: An attempt was made to create a new Import/Export relationship for an MPAN that is already part of another such relationship.
REG1052.resolution: Dissolve the existing Import/Export relationship before attempting to create a new one for the specified MPAN(s).

REG1053.description: Proposed Principal MPAN in Import/Export Relationship must be Import
REG1053.reason: The MPAN designated as the 'Principal' in an Import/Export relationship must have an energy direction of Import.
REG1053.resolution: Verify the energy direction of the proposed Principal MPAN. Only an Import MPAN can be designated as the Principal.

REG1054.description: Proposed Subsidiary MPAN(s) in Import/Export Relationship must be Export
REG1054.reason: All MPANs designated as 'Subsidiary' in an Import/Export relationship must have an energy direction of Export.
REG1054.resolution: Verify the energy direction of all proposed Subsidiary MPANs. Only Export MPANs can be designated as Subsidiary in this relationship type.

REG1055.description: Proposed Principal MPAN is not currently part of an Import/Export Relationship
REG1055.reason: An attempt was made to modify or dissolve a relationship by referencing a Principal MPAN that is not part of any existing relationship.
REG1055.resolution: Verify the Principal MPAN is correct and is part of an active Import/Export relationship before attempting to modify it.

REG1056.description: Proposed Subsidiary MPAN(s) is a member of a separate Import/Export Relationship
REG1056.reason: The subsidiary MPAN being added to a relationship is already part of a different Import/Export relationship.
REG1056.resolution: An MPAN can only be in one Import/Export relationship at a time. Remove it from the existing relationship before adding it to a new one.

REG1057.description: Proposed Subsididary MPAN(s) is already in a Relationship with the Proposed Principle
REG1057.reason: An attempt was made to add a subsidiary MPAN to a relationship where it already exists.
REG1057.resolution: Do not attempt to add an MPAN to a relationship it is already a part of. Verify the existing relationship members before submitting the update.

REG1058.description: Proposed Subsidiary MPAN is not currently part of an Import/Export Relationship
REG1058.reason: An attempt was made to remove a subsidiary MPAN from a relationship, but the MPAN is not part of any relationship.
REG1058.resolution: Verify the MPAN ID. No action is needed if the goal was to ensure the MPAN is not in a relationship.

REG1059.description: MPAN(s) cannot be duplicated within same message
REG1059.reason: The same MPAN Core was listed more than once within a single relationship management request.
REG1059.resolution: Ensure each MPAN is listed only once in the request payload and resubmit.

REG1060.description: Supplier must have ownership of All MPANs to maintain Relationships
REG1060.reason: An attempt was made to create or modify a 'Related MPAN' relationship without being the registered supplier for all involved MPANs.
REG1060.resolution: Verify that the requesting supplier is the current supplier for all MPANs involved in the 'Related MPAN' relationship.

REG1061.description: Proposed MPAN(s) are already part of a Related MPAN Relationship
REG1061.reason: One or more of the MPANs in the request are already members of an existing 'Related MPAN' group.
REG1061.resolution: First, dissolve the existing relationship for the relevant MPANs before creating a new one.

REG1062.description: Proposed Principal MPAN is not the Primary MPAN in an existing Relationship
REG1062.reason: A request to modify a 'Related MPAN' relationship referenced a Principal MPAN that is not the primary MPAN of any existing group.
REG1062.resolution: Verify the MPAN ID and ensure you are referencing the correct Primary MPAN for the relationship you intend to modify.

REG1063.description: Proposed Subsidiary MPAN is already in an MPAN Relationship with Primary MPAN
REG1063.reason: The request tried to add a secondary MPAN to a related group where it is already a member.
REG1063.resolution: Verify the current members of the relationship. Do not try to add an MPAN that is already part of the group.

REG1064.description: Proposed Secondary MPAN is already part of a different MPAN Relationship
REG1064.reason: The secondary MPAN being added is already part of a different 'Related MPAN' group.
REG1064.resolution: An MPAN can only be in one 'Related MPAN' relationship at a time. Remove it from its current group before adding it to another.

REG1065.description: Proposed Subsidiary MPAN(s) not in a Related Relationship with Principal MPAN Referenced
REG1065.reason: A request was made to remove a secondary MPAN from a group, but it was not a member of that specific group.
REG1065.resolution: Verify that the secondary MPAN is actually part of the relationship associated with the referenced Principal MPAN before attempting removal.

REG1067.description: Only Import MPANs can become Related
REG1067.reason: The 'Related MPAN' relationship type is only applicable to MPANs with an energy direction of Import.
REG1067.resolution: Ensure all MPANs included in a 'Related MPAN' relationship request are Import MPANs.

REG1071.description: CDC Effective Date cannot be Retrospective
REG1071.reason: The start date for the Consumption Data Class (CDC) marker is in the past.
REG1071.resolution: To resolve this, ensure that the CDC 'effective from' date is the current date or a future date. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1072.description: CDC End Date Extends Beyond Maximum Allowed
REG1072.reason: The requested end date for the Consumption Data Class (CDC) marker is more than the maximum allowed duration (e.g., 2 years) from the start date.
REG1072.resolution: To resolve this, ensure that the CDC end date is less than the CDC 'effective from' date + 2 years. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1073.description: CDC Already Exists for the Period Requested
REG1073.reason: A Consumption Data Class (CDC) marker is already active for this MPAN and the requested new period overlaps with the existing one.
REG1073.resolution: To resolve this, ensure that the new CDC start date is after the existing CDC end date. Please check your data and resubmit.

REG1074.description: Cannot Remove as no CDC Data Exists for Participant
REG1074.reason: A request was made to remove a Consumption Data Class (CDC) marker, but no such marker exists for the specified participant and MPAN.
REG1074.resolution: Verify that a CDC marker is currently active for the participant before attempting to remove it. No action is needed if the intent was to ensure no marker exists.

REG1076.description: Sender ID must equal CDC DIP ID
REG1076.reason: The ID of the party sending the request to manage a CDC marker does not match the ID of the party that owns the marker.
REG1076.resolution: Ensure the request to manage or remove a CDC marker is sent by the same party (DIP ID) that created it.

REG1080.description: MDR Update only available to Currently Appointed Data Service
REG1080.reason: An attempt to update the Meter Data Retriever (MDR) was made by a party that is not the currently appointed Data Service for the MPAN.
REG1080.resolution: Verify that the sender of the MDR update request is the currently appointed Data Service.

REG1081.description: MDR ID is not a valid MDR
REG1081.reason: The provided Meter Data Retriever (MDR) ID is not a valid identifier found in Industry Standing Data (ISD).
REG1081.resolution: Check the provided MDR ID against the ISD catalogue and correct it before resubmitting.

REG1082.description: MDR Effective From Date cannot be more than [x] days in the future
REG1082.reason: The proposed start date for the Meter Data Retriever (MDR) appointment is too far in the future, exceeding the allowed lead time.
REG1082.resolution: Adjust the MDR 'Effective From' Date to be within the allowed future window (e.g., 28 days) and resubmit.

REG1083.description: MDR Effective From Date does not align with SSD/Existing MDR Eff. From Date
REG1083.reason: The proposed start date for the new Meter Data Retriever (MDR) is not contiguous with the Supplier Start Date (SSD) or the end date of the previous MDR.
REG1083.resolution: Ensure the MDR 'Effective From' Date creates a continuous timeline with no gaps or overlaps from the previous appointment.

REG1084.description: Supplier Referenced is not Current Supplier
REG1084.reason: An action was performed that referenced a Supplier ID that is not the currently registered supplier for the MPAN.
REG1084.resolution: Verify the Supplier ID and ensure the action is being performed in the context of the currently appointed supplier.

REG1088.description: Effective From Date Must be Provided
REG1088.reason: A mandatory 'Effective From Date' was not included in the request.
REG1088.resolution: Please provide the required 'Effective From Date' for the event and resubmit.

REG1089.reason: A new prospective service provider appointment has been received which supersedes a previous one that was pending.
REG1089.resolution: This is often informational. The later appointment request has been accepted as the valid one. No action may be needed unless the superseded appointment was intended to be the active one.

REG1090.description: Proposed Metering Service MPID does not match DIP ID
REG1090.reason: The Market Participant ID (MPID) provided for the Metering Service does not match the associated Data Interchange Protocol (DIP) ID.
REG1090.resolution: Verify and correct the MPID and DIP ID for the proposed Metering Service to ensure they correspond to the same entity.

REG1091.description: Proposed Data Service MPID does not match DIP ID
REG1091.reason: The Market Participant ID (MPID) provided for the Data Service does not match the associated Data Interchange Protocol (DIP) ID.
REG1091.resolution: Verify and correct the MPID and DIP ID for the proposed Data Service to ensure they correspond to the same entity.

REG1092.description: Supplier Nominated MDR MPID does not match DIP ID
REG1092.reason: The Market Participant ID (MPID) provided for the Supplier-nominated MDR does not match the associated Data Interchange Protocol (DIP) ID.
REG1092.resolution: Verify and correct the MPID and DIP ID for the Supplier-nominated MDR to ensure they correspond to the same entity.

REG1093.description: SDS Nominated MDR MPID does not match DIP ID
REG1093.reason: The Market Participant ID (MPID) provided for the SDS-nominated MDR does not match the associated Data Interchange Protocol (DIP) ID.
REG1093.resolution: Verify and correct the MPID and DIP ID for the SDS-nominated MDR to ensure they correspond to the same entity.

REG1094.reason: A response code was sent that is not a valid or recognized code within the system.
REG1094.resolution: Check the list of valid response codes for this process and submit a valid one.

REG1095.description: Proposed Service Provider cannot be currently appointed Service Provider for SEG appointment
REG1095.reason: An attempt was made to appoint a Service Provider for a Smart Export Guarantee (SEG) role, but that provider is already appointed in a different capacity.
REG1095.resolution: Ensure the proposed Service Provider for the SEG appointment is not the same as the currently appointed provider for other roles.

REG1096.description: IHD effective from date cannot be before meter installation date
REG1096.reason: The date recorded for the In-Home Display (IHD) status is earlier than the installation date of the associated smart meter.
REG1096.resolution: Correct the IHD 'effective from' date to be on or after the smart meter's installation date.

REG1097.description: Number of digits not compatible with Meter Type
REG1097.reason: The value for 'Number of Displayed Register Digits' is not valid for the specified meter type (e.g., providing a value for a meter type that doesn't have a display).
REG1097.resolution: Verify the correct value for the number of digits for the specified meter type and resubmit.

REG1098.description: Proposed MDR cannot be currently appointed MDR
REG1098.reason: A request was made to appoint a Meter Data Retriever (MDR) that is already the current MDR for the MPAN.
REG1098.resolution: Check the currently appointed MDR. You can only submit a request to appoint a new, different MDR.

REG1099.description: SP Effective from date cannot be more than 28 days in the future
REG1099.reason: The proposed start date for a service provider appointment is more than 28 days in the future, exceeding the maximum lead time.
REG1099.resolution: Adjust the 'effective from' date to be within the next 28 days.

REG1100.description: The MPAN is not currently live on the DCC network
REG1100.reason: The MPAN for which the request is being made has not been activated or is not currently active on the DCC network.
REG1100.resolution: Ensure the MPAN is active and enrolled on the DCC network before making this request.

REG1101.description: The Metering Service cannot de-appoint itself
REG1101.reason: A Metering Service is attempting to de-appoint its own appointment. De-appointments must be initiated by an external party, such as a supplier.
REG1101.resolution: The de-appointment request must come from a third party (supplier). The Metering Service cannot self-de-appoint.

REG1102.description: The Data Service cannot de-appoint itself
REG1102.reason: A Data Service is attempting to de-appoint its own appointment. De-appointments must be initiated by an external party, such as a supplier.

REG1104.resolution: Check the documentation for the event to see which appointment scenarios are supported. Correct the scenario code and resubmit.

REG1105.description: The Supplier ID is invalid for the specified event
REG1105.reason: The supplier ID provided in the message is not valid for the action being requested. For example, a supplier ID for a 'change of supplier' event might be for a supplier that is not the current supplier.
REG1105.resolution: Verify the supplier ID against the business rules for the specific event and correct it as needed.

REG1106.description: The meter is not a smart meter

REG1107.description: Data item not applicable to this event

REG1107.resolution: Review the data items required for the specific event and remove any that are not applicable. Resubmit the message with only the required and optional data items.

REG1108.reason: The message composition is invalid. This could be due to missing a mandatory block, including a block that is conditionally mandatory when its condition is not met, or including an optional block that is not permitted for the event.

REG1109.description: Message composition has an invalid structure

REG9006.description: MCS Appointment Scenario Cannot be Used by Current Supplier

REG9007.description: MCS/MCA Scenarios cannot be used for an Already Migrated MPAN
REG9007.resolution: The 'MCS' or 'MCA' appointment scenarios are not applicable as the MPAN is already operating under the MHHS regime.

REG9008.description: MCS/MCA Scenarios cannot be used by a Non-Qualified Supplier

ECS1001.description: Data Service Not Appointed for Date of SP Submission
ECS1001.reason: The Data Service attempted to submit consumption data for a Settlement Period for which they were not the appointed party.
ECS1001.resolution: Verify the Data Service appointment dates and ensure the consumption submission falls entirely within the period of responsibility.

ECS1002.reason: The Metering System Query ID (MQID) used is not appropriate for the type of event being submitted.
ECS1002.resolution: Check the documentation for the correct MQID to use for this specific event type and resubmit.

ECS1003.description: SP End Date/Time has already past 'MDS Run Date (RF)'
ECS1003.reason: The consumption data was submitted for a Settlement Period that is already closed for updates (i.e., after the Reckoning Finalisation 'RF' run).
ECS1003.resolution: Consumption data cannot be amended after the RF settlement run. No action can be taken to submit this data.

ECS1004.reason: The duration specified for the settlement period is not valid (e.g., not a 30-minute interval).
ECS1004.resolution: Ensure the Settlement Period duration is correctly specified as per industry standards.

ECS1005.description: SP End Date / Time invalid for Settlement Period Duration
ECS1005.reason: The end date and time of the settlement period does not align correctly with the specified duration (e.g., does not end on the hour or half-hour).
ECS1005.resolution: Correct the Settlement Period End Date/Time to align with the standard settlement intervals.

ECS1006.description: SP End Date/Time duplicated with SP in same message
ECS1006.reason: The same Settlement Period has been included more than once in a single submission message.
ECS1006.resolution: Remove the duplicate Settlement Period entry from the message and resubmit.

ECS1007.description: SP End Date/Time overlaps with SP in same message
ECS1007.reason: The submission contains multiple Settlement Periods whose time intervals overlap.
ECS1007.resolution: Correct the Settlement Period intervals to ensure they are distinct and do not overlap, then resubmit.

ECS1008.description: SP End Date/Time contains non-Actual Consumption for ECS De-Energised MPAN
ECS1008.reason: Consumption data other than 'Actual' has been submitted for an MPAN that is in a de-energised state.
ECS1008.resolution: For a de-energised MPAN, only actual consumption (which should be zero) can be submitted. Correct the data and resubmit.

ECS1009.description: Consumption cannot be recorded due to ECS MPAN Status
ECS1009.reason: The MPAN's current status (e.g., disconnected) prohibits the submission of consumption data.
ECS1009.resolution: Verify the MPAN status. Consumption data can only be submitted for MPANs in an appropriate state (e.g., energised).

ECS1010.reason: A negative value was submitted for energy consumption.
ECS1010.resolution: Consumption values must be zero or positive. Correct the value and resubmit.

ECS1011.description: Consumption Value must be Zero if Estimation Code is Type 'ZE'
ECS1011.reason: An estimation code indicating 'Zero Estimation' (ZE) was used, but the consumption value provided was not zero.
ECS1011.resolution: If using a 'ZE' estimation code, the consumption value must be 0. Correct the value or the code and resubmit.

ECS1012.description: Consumption Value for SP is greater than ECS Maximum Permitted
ECS1012.reason: The submitted consumption value for a single Settlement Period exceeds the system's maximum allowed threshold.
ECS1012.resolution: Verify the consumption value for correctness. If it is abnormally high, it may indicate a meter or data error that needs investigation.

ECS1013.description: SP End Date/Time is prior to Connection Type EffectiveFrom Date
ECS1013.reason: Consumption data has been submitted for a period before the MPAN's connection was effective.
ECS1013.resolution: Ensure that consumption data is only submitted for periods on or after the MPAN's connection effective date.

ECS1014.reason: The UTC timestamp for the settlement day did not start at midnight (00:00:00).
ECS1014.resolution: Ensure the UTC Settlement Date/Time is correctly formatted and represents the start of the day.

ECS1015.description: Estimation Reason Code Cannot be Null
ECS1015.reason: Estimated consumption data was submitted without a mandatory reason code explaining why the data was estimated.
ECS1015.resolution: Provide a valid Estimation Reason Code along with the estimated consumption data and resubmit.

ECS1016.description: Consumption Amendment Reason Codes Cannot be Null
ECS1016.reason: A consumption amendment was submitted without a mandatory reason code.
ECS1016.resolution: Provide a valid reason code for the consumption amendment and resubmit.

SP000.reason: The service provider has accepted the proposed appointment.
SP000.resolution: This is a success code. No action is required.

SP001.reason: The service provider has no valid commercial contract in place with the requesting supplier.
SP001.resolution: The supplier must establish a contract with the service provider before appointments can be made.

SP002.description: Contract Ref not valid for Supplier
SP002.reason: The contract reference provided in the appointment request is not valid for the supplier.
SP002.resolution: Verify the correct contract reference and resubmit the appointment request.

SP003.description: Contract Ref not valid for Connection Type or Market Segment
SP003.reason: The contract in place between the supplier and service provider does not cover the specific connection type or market segment of the MPAN.
SP003.resolution: Check the terms of the contract or appoint a different service provider that supports the MPAN's characteristics.

SP004.reason: The service provider does not support the connection type of the MPAN (e.g., Whole Current, CT Operated).
SP004.resolution: Appoint a different service provider that supports the MPAN's connection type.

SP005.reason: The service provider does not operate in the market segment of the MPAN (e.g., Smart, Advanced).
SP005.resolution: Appoint a different service provider that supports the MPAN's market segment.

SP006.reason: The service provider is not accredited to work with the type of meter installed at the property.
SP006.resolution: Appoint a different service provider that supports the installed meter type.

SP007.reason: The location of the MPAN is outside the geographical area served by the service provider.
SP007.resolution: Appoint a different service provider that operates in the MPAN's geographical area.

SP008.reason: The address details provided for the MPAN are not sufficient or are considered invalid by the service provider.
SP008.resolution: Correct or enhance the address information for the MPAN and resubmit the appointment request.

SP009.reason: The service provider requires the meter to be enrolled with the Data Communications Company (DCC), but it is not.
SP009.resolution: Ensure the meter is enrolled on the DCC network before appointing this service provider.

SP010.reason: The service provider's services are restricted based on whether the premise is domestic or non-domestic, and this MPAN does not match their supported type.
SP010.resolution: Verify the domestic indicator for the MPAN and appoint a service provider that supports that premise type.

SP011.description: Insufficient Notice / Lead Time for Appointment to take effect
SP011.reason: The proposed start date for the appointment does not meet the minimum notice period required by the service provider.
SP011.resolution: Adjust the appointment effective date to comply with the service provider's required lead time.

SP099.reason: The service provider has rejected the appointment for a reason not covered by the other specific codes.
SP099.resolution: Contact the service provider directly to understand the specific reason for the rejection.

DS001.reason: The Data Service does not support or have a working relationship with the Meter Data Retriever (MDR) nominated by the supplier.
DS001.resolution: The supplier must nominate an MDR that is supported by the appointed Data Service.

DS002.reason: The Data Service does not support the Smart Metering System Operator (SMSO) associated with the MPAN.
DS002.resolution: Appoint a different Data Service that supports the MPAN's SMSO.

DS003.description: Trad/ Fall Back Read Freq Invalid / Missing
DS003.reason: The required frequency for traditional or fall-back meter reads was not provided or is not supported by the Data Service.
DS003.resolution: Provide a valid and supported meter reading frequency in the appointment request.

DS004.reason: The effective date for the change of MDR does not provide enough lead time for the Data Service to action.
DS004.resolution: Resubmit the MDR change request with an effective date that meets the Data Service's minimum notice period.

DS005.description: Change of MDR - Cannot be Retrospective
DS005.reason: An attempt was made to change the MDR with an effective date in the past.
DS005.resolution: A change of MDR can only be effective from the current date onwards. Adjust the date and resubmit.

DS006.description: Change of MDR - Lead Time Too Large
DS006.reason: The effective date for the change of MDR is too far in the future.
DS006.resolution: Adjust the effective date to be within the maximum allowed lead time set by the Data Service.

DSCA001.description: Consumption Amendment Period is wholly outside period of responsibility
DSCA001.resolution: Verify the dates for the consumption amendment. Ensure the entire period falls within your period of responsibility before resubmitting.

DSCA002.description: Consumption Amendment Period is partially outside period of responsibility
DSCA002.resolution: Verify the dates for the consumption amendment. Ensure the start and end dates of the period are fully within your period of responsibility.

DSCA003.description: Consumption Amendment Period is wholly outside pre-RF period
DSCA003.resolution: The consumption amendment period must be within the pre-Reckoning Finalisation (pre-RF) period. Please check the dates and resubmit.

DSCA004.description: Consumption Amendment Period is partially outside pre-RF period
DSCA004.resolution: The consumption amendment period must be entirely within the pre-Reckoning Finalisation (pre-RF) period. Please adjust the dates.

DSCA005.description: Provided Gross Consumption is below Consumption Amendment Threshold
DSCA005.resolution: The gross consumption value submitted is below the allowed threshold for an amendment. No action is needed unless the value was submitted in error.

DSCA006.description: Apportioned Pre-RF Consumption is below Consumption Amendment Threshold
DSCA006.resolution: The apportioned pre-Reckoning Finalisation (pre-RF) consumption is below the amendment threshold. No action is needed unless the value was submitted in error.

DSCA007.description: Provided Gross Consumption is outside of agreed Business Rules
DSCA007.resolution: The gross consumption value submitted does not comply with agreed business rules. Please review the rules and the submitted value.

DSCA008.description: Apportioned Pre-RF Consumption is outside of agreed Business Rules
DSCA008.resolution: The apportioned pre-Reckoning Finalisation (pre-RF) consumption value does not comply with agreed business rules. Please review the rules and the submitted value.

DSCA009.description: Supplier Reference expected but not provided
DSCA009.resolution: A Supplier Reference is required but was not included. Please provide a valid Supplier Reference and resubmit.

DSCA010.description: Supplier Reference has already been used
DSCA010.resolution: The provided Supplier Reference has already been used for a previous submission. Please provide a unique reference.

DSCA011.resolution: The reason code provided is either invalid or unknown. Please check the valid reason codes and resubmit.

DSCA012.description: Reason Code used is outside of agreed Business Rules
DSCA012.resolution: The reason code provided is not valid under the currently agreed business rules. Please review the rules and use an appropriate code.

DSCA013.resolution: The Active Power consumption value is a required field and was not provided. Please include Active Power data and resubmit.

DSCA014.description: Reactive Power provided but not expected/required
DSCA014.resolution: Reactive Power data was provided but is not expected or required for this submission. Please remove the Reactive Power data and resubmit.

DSCA015.description: Supplier Consumption Amendment Reason Code not provided
DSCA015.resolution: A reason code for the consumption amendment is required but was not provided. Please include a valid reason code and resubmit.

DSCA999.resolution: The submission was rejected for an unspecified reason. Please review the entire submission for compliance with business rules and data standards.

routingRules: For Change of Supply, IF-041 may be secondary routed to both the Incoming Supplier and Outgoing Supplier where required to support sharing of COS reads.

For a Change of Segment, the Metering Service sends the removal read before the segment change and the install read after the segment change.
